name: SlideShowWindows
description: A collection of all the SlideShowWindow objects that represent the open slide shows in Microsoft PowerPoint.
example:
With SlideShowWindows(1)

    If .IsFullScreen Then

        .Height = .Height - 20

    End If

End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single SlideShowWindow object from the specified SlideShowWindows collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single SlideShowWindow object in the collection to be returned.
